Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the WebSurfer’s results and incorrectly asserted that Sun Capital Partners owned Maxeda since 2004. The sources shown (Wikipedia and Private Equity International) indicated KKR (Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co.) and a KKR-led consortium. This faulty synthesis introduced the wrong owner and could have led to an incorrect final answer.
